reason: A host adapter that provides real-time code diagnostics, formatting, structural analysis, navigation, and configurable autofixes while an agent edits a workspace.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时的代码诊断、格式化、结构分析、导航和可配置自动修复功能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with real-time code diagnostics, formatting, structural analysis, navigation, and configurable autofixes.

capabilities: Runs formatters, linters, LSP diagnostics, type-checking, and structural code analysis after write, edit, or bash mutations
May apply configured safe autofixes and formatting changes
Provides code navigation, symbol search, project reports, and dependency mapping
Injects diagnostics, blockers, and advisories into subsequent model requests
Exposes WebUI session controls and diagnostic displays
